# ChannelTheory.Stinespring

**Stinespring 等距扩张**

从任意有限维 CPTP 映射实际构造有限环境等距扩张，证明对任意纠缠参考输入的偏迹等于原信道，并补 clean 环境下的酉补全与维数预算，给出恒等、丢弃和非酉信道的真实消费者。

**边界**：不假设待证 dilation，不覆盖 Naimark 测量扩张与 twirl，也不把非酉信道消费者当作完备性结论。

**覆盖等级**：A

| `Qatlib.Concepts.ChannelTheory.Stinespring.clause2_conj2` | theorem | L440 | A finite-dimensional complex-linear map is completely positive exactly when it possesses a Kraus representation with at most `D * E` terms [Choi1975]. |
| `Qatlib.Concepts.ChannelTheory.Stinespring.clause2_conj4_mpr` | theorem | L451 | The existence of a complete Kraus representation with at most `D * E` terms implies trace preservation. |
| `Qatlib.Concepts.ChannelTheory.Stinespring.clause2_conj11` | theorem | L459 | Every bundled quantum channel has a positive semidefinite Choi matrix and a complete Kraus representation with at most `D * E` terms. |
| `Qatlib.Concepts.ChannelTheory.Stinespring.clause2_conj12` | theorem | L470 | Every complete finite Kraus family defines a bundled quantum channel with that Kraus representation and with Physlib complete positivity and trace preservation. |
| `Qatlib.Concepts.ChannelTheory.Stinespring.transposeMap` | def | L484 | Matrix transposition as a complex-linear endomorphism of the operator space. |
| `Qatlib.Concepts.ChannelTheory.Stinespring.transposeMap_apply` | theorem | L488 | Applying `transposeMap D` to an operator returns its transpose. |
| `Qatlib.Concepts.ChannelTheory.Stinespring.transposeMap_tracePreserving` | theorem | L492 | Matrix transposition preserves the trace in every finite dimension. |
| `Qatlib.Concepts.ChannelTheory.Stinespring.wAnti` | def | L499 | The antisymmetric two-qubit vector with coefficients one at `(0, 1)` and minus one at `(1, 0)`. |
| `Qatlib.Concepts.ChannelTheory.Stinespring.wAnti_swap` | theorem | L503 | Swapping the two indices negates the vector `wAnti`. |
| `Qatlib.Concepts.ChannelTheory.Stinespring.choi_transposeMap_apply` | theorem | L509 | The Choi matrix of transposition has entry one exactly when the input-output indices are paired in the swapped order. |
| `Qatlib.Concepts.ChannelTheory.Stinespring.transposeMap_two_quadratic` | theorem | L519 | The quadratic form of the qubit transpose Choi matrix at `wAnti` equals `-2`. |
| `Qatlib.Concepts.ChannelTheory.Stinespring.transposeMap_two_not_completelyPositive` | theorem | L537 | The transpose map on qubit operators is not completely positive. |
